queries: WITH pair AS (SELECT f.orderslink, u.acctscope, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_feerate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope), scored AS (SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, avg_feerate - AVG(avg_feerate) OVER () AS excess FROM pair), kept AS (SELECT * FROM scored WHERE excess > 0), ranked AS (SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY acctscope ORDER BY excess DESC) AS rnk FROM kept) SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, rnk AS rank FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 3

WITH pair_avg AS (SELECT f.orderslink AS orderslink, u.acctscope AS acctscope, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_feerate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope HAVING AVG(f.feerate) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_feerate) AS mean_avg FROM pair_avg), kept AS (SELECT p.orderslink, p.acctscope, p.avg_feerate, p.avg_feerate - o.mean_avg AS excess FROM pair_avg p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_feerate > o.mean_avg), ranked AS (SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY acctscope ORDER BY excess DESC) AS rnk FROM kept) SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, rnk AS rank FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY acctscope, rnk, orderslink

assumptions.assumption: The overall mean is taken across all (orderslink, acctscope) pair averages computed after the inner joins, before filtering. Each pair counts once, regardless of how many fee rows it has. Pairs whose feerate values are all NULL have a NULL average and are left out of that mean and cannot be kept.
orders.recordvault and users.userstamp are each unique, so the joins do not duplicate fee rows.

assumptions.assumption: The mean of all pair averages is computed over every (orderslink, acctscope) pair, before filtering, and each pair is weighted equally (not weighted by fee count). Pairs whose feerate values are all NULL have no average and are excluded from the mean.
The inner joins drop fees with no matching order or user. Ranking is by excess within acctscope, descending, using RANK so ties share a rank and the next rank skips ahead.

assumptions.assumption: Pairs whose feerate values are all NULL have no average and are excluded from the pair set, so they do not enter the overall mean.
The mean of all pair averages is the unweighted mean across all pairs (not partitioned by account scope and not weighted by fee count).
Orders with a NULL userlink or users with no match are dropped by the inner joins; if users.userstamp is not unique, duplicate user rows could affect averages.
